verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only single-file transcription: one audio/video file or URL per request. Async webhook delivery and multichannel transcription of a single file are adjacent features, not a bulk operation across many items. A speech-to-text API could plausibly offer batch jobs, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack shows a batch or bulk endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
